summary: Transform your workforce with our High-Impact Employee Training Programs Course. Boost skills, engagement, and productivity today!
lede: Corporate training programs help HR and learning professionals turn performance needs into targeted learning. This course is for people who design, manage, or evaluate employee development and shows how to identify skill and performance gaps, connect learning objectives to organizational goals, choose suitable methods, and evaluate results using feedback and performance data.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who design, manage, or evaluate training initiatives in various sectors.
modules: Understanding the Strategic Role of Training
Driving Continuous Learning and Knowledge Retention
Future Trends in Learning and Development
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of training principles and experience in a training or HR-related role. Access to a computer and internet is required for online resources and assignments.
